text: This report recommends the naming of a new park on Cleanside Road, a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division (PFR) is recommending that the future park located on Cleanside Road, be officially named "GECo Park". The Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division has reviewed the policy criteria in the Council-approved "City of Toronto Property Naming Policy" and verifies that the proposed park name meets the criteria.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Officially named the future park located on Cleanside Road in Scarborough "GECo Park".
